facts.text: Serve the snacks when Chunk is made to do his dance at the gate.
facts.why: Mouth makes Chunk do the Truffle Shuffle before letting him into the Walsh house. No gate appears in the transcript or plot.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Chunk is made to do the Truffle Shuffle to get in.

facts.text: I'll confess to anything you want, I swear. Just keep the pizza coming and nobody mentions the blender.
facts.why: Chunk never says this. His confession to the Fratellis is 'Everything. Okay, I'll talk. In third grade, I cheated on my history exam...'. The blender line is invented.
facts.fix: Geez, mister. You're even hungrier than I am.
